_comment: TEMPLATE -- contains no real data. Copy to ~/.claude/qoyod/companies.json
and fill in your own companies. Keep that file off OneDrive and shared
drives; it is never committed to this repository.
Add one block per client company. The block's key is the slug you pass
name             REQUIRED. The legal name EXACTLY as Qoyod holds it,
which in practice means Arabic. It is matched against
the customer name printed on each invoice, so do not
translate or tidy it -- that blocks correct invoices.
vat              REQUIRED. The company's own VAT number, 15 digits.
expense_account  REQUIRED. Default expense account code, e.g. 5101.
api_key_env      Name of an environment variable holding the API key.
api_key          The key inline instead. Prefer api_key_env, so the key
name_en          Optional, display only. Never matched.
inventory_id     Optional. Pins the location; otherwise the tenant's
Delete this _comment block and the empty entry below once you have added
